f.title: Meet the GVP ordinance standard for post-marketing safety management as a condition of the MAH licence
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder licence (Article 12(1)) for drugs, quasi-drugs or cosmetics may be refused where the applicant's quality management method does not conform to the standard set by MHLW ordinance (item 1), or where its post-marketing safety management method does not conform to the standard set by MHLW ordinance (item 2). Post-marketing safety management is defined here as the collection and examination of information on quality, efficacy and safety and other information needed for proper use, and the necessary measures based on the results. The MAH must therefore have a post-marketing safety management system that meets the MHLW ordinance standard (GVP); the content of that standard is set by ordinance, not by the Act.

rows.quote_en: A marketing authorisation holder of drugs, medical devices or regenerative medicine products shall, when marketing drugs or medical devices designated by the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare or regenerative medicine products, notify the Minister in advance, as provided by MHLW ordinance, of those matters set by MHLW ordinance, such as the precautions necessary for use and handling, among the matters listed in the items of Article 52(2) or specified in Article 68-2(2)(1) for the drug, the matters listed in the items of Article 63-2(2) or specified in Article 68-2(2)(2) for the medical device, or the matters specified in item 3 of that paragraph for the regenerative medicine product. The same applies when intending to change them.

f.title: Publish the notified precautions immediately after notification
f.statement: After making the notification under Article 68-2-3(1), the MAH must immediately, as provided by MHLW ordinance, publish the notified items by an electronic data processing or other information and communications technology method.
f.clause: Article 68-2-3, paragraph 2 (第六十八条の二の三第二項)

f.statement: Where the Minister has assigned to PMDA the receipt of notifications under Article 68-2-3(1), the notification for designated drugs or medical devices, or regenerative medicine products, must be made to PMDA, as provided by MHLW ordinance, instead of to the Minister. PMDA then notifies the Minister (paragraph 3).

f.title: Mark containers with a product identification code and take other ordinance measures to support product identification
f.statement: To provide information that helps identify products smoothly, the MAH must, according to the categories set by MHLW ordinance, mark the container with a code identifying the drug, medical device or regenerative medicine product and take other measures set by MHLW ordinance.
f.clause: Article 68-2-5 (第六十八条の二の五) (Product identification code)

rows.quote: 医薬品、医療機器又は再生医療等製品の製造販売業者は、厚生労働省令で定める区分に応じ、医薬品、医療機器又は再生医療等製品の特定に資する情報を円滑に提供するため、医薬品、医療機器又は再生医療等製品を特定するための符号のこれらの容器への表示その他の厚生労働省令で定める措置を講じなければならない。

f.title: Endeavour to collect, examine and provide safety and proper-use information to healthcare professionals
f.statement: MAHs, wholesalers (including medical device and regenerative product wholesalers as defined) and foreign special approval holders must endeavour to collect and examine information on the efficacy and safety of drugs, medical devices or regenerative medicine products and other information needed for their proper use, and to provide it to pharmacy founders, hospital, clinic and veterinary clinic founders, sellers, lessors and repairers, and physicians, dentists, pharmacists, veterinarians and other medical and pharmaceutical professionals.

f.applicability: Japan; PMD Act (医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律, Act No. 145 of 1960), Japanese original text from e-Gov (capture r2). Drugs, medical devices and regenerative medicine products.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Safety communications; Signal detection

rows.actor: MAHs, wholesalers and foreign special approval holders (外国特例承認取得者)
rows.quote: 医薬品、医療機器若しくは再生医療等製品の製造販売業者、卸売販売業者、医療機器卸売販売業者等（医療機器の販売業者又は貸与業者のうち、薬局開設者、医療機器の製造販売業者、販売業者若しくは貸与業者若しくは病院、診療所若しくは飼育動物診療施設の開設者に対し、業として、医療機器を販売し、若しくは授与するもの又は薬局開設者若しくは病院、診療所若しくは飼育動物診療施設の開設者に対し、業として、医療機器を貸与するものをいう。次項において同じ。）、再生医療等製品卸売販売業者（再生医療等製品の販売業者のうち、再生医療等製品の製造販売業者若しくは販売業者又は病院、診療所若しくは飼育動物診療施設の開設者に対し、業として、再生医療等製品を販売し、又は授与するものをいう。同項において同じ。）又は外国製造医薬品等特例承認取得者、外国製造医療機器等特例承認取得者若しくは外国製造再生医療等製品特例承認取得者（以下「外国特例承認取得者」と総称する。）は、医薬品、医療機器又は再生医療等製品の有効性及び安全性に関する事項その他医薬品、医療機器又は再生医療等製品の適正な使用のために必要な情報（第六十八条の二第二項第二号ロの規定による指定がされた医療機器の保守点検に関する情報を含む。次項において同じ。）を収集し、及び検討するとともに、薬局開設者、病院、診療所若しくは飼育動物診療施設の開設者、医薬品の販売業者、医療機器の販売業者、貸与業者若しくは修理業者、再生医療等製品の販売業者又は医師、歯科医師、薬剤師、獣医師その他の医薬関係者に対し、これを提供するよう努めなければならない。
rows.location: Article 68-2-6, paragraph 1 (第六十八条の二の六第一項) (Provision of information)
rows.review_note: Single-agent curation: extract, review and double-check passes were run by one agent, not three separate agents. Review: quote verified verbatim. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 努めなければならない is a statutory duty to endeavour; GUIDE maps 努める forms to Recommended, which understates its legal force for a Japanese reader; level kept Recommended per GUIDE and confidence held below 90 pending SME ruling. Independent review: title fixed: 努めなければならない governs the whole sentence (収集し、及び検討するとともに…提供するよう努めなければならない), so collection and examination are also duties to endeavour, not absolute duties as the old title read. Level kept Recommended per GUIDE. 88 is right: in Japanese law this is a statutory duty to endeavour (努力義務) with no penalty, which the Recommended label only approximates, so a person should confirm the label before it publishes.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders of drugs, medical devices or regenerative medicine products, wholesalers, medical device wholesalers etc. (sellers or lessors of medical devices who, as a business, sell or supply medical devices to pharmacy founders, medical device MAHs, sellers or lessors, or hospital, clinic or veterinary clinic founders, or lease them to pharmacy founders or hospital, clinic or veterinary clinic founders; the same applies in the next paragraph), regenerative medicine product wholesalers (sellers who, as a business, sell or supply regenerative medicine products to their MAHs or sellers or to hospital, clinic or veterinary clinic founders; the same applies in that paragraph), or foreign special approval holders for drugs, medical devices or regenerative medicine products (collectively "foreign special approval holders") shall endeavour to collect and examine information on the efficacy and safety of these products and other information necessary for their proper use (including maintenance and inspection information for medical devices designated under Article 68-2(2)(2)(b); the same applies in the next paragraph), and to provide it to pharmacy founders, hospital, clinic or veterinary clinic founders, sellers of drugs, sellers, lessors or repairers of medical devices, sellers of regenerative medicine products, or physicians, dentists, pharmacists, veterinarians and other medical and pharmaceutical professionals.

f.title: Healthcare professionals, institutions and academic bodies: endeavour to cooperate with MAH information collection
f.statement: Pharmacy founders, hospital, clinic and veterinary clinic founders, sellers, lessors and repairers, physicians, dentists, pharmacists, veterinarians and other medical and pharmaceutical professionals, and academic societies, universities, research institutions and others set by MHLW ordinance must endeavour to cooperate with the collection of information needed for proper use carried out by MAHs, wholesalers and foreign special approval holders.
f.clause: Article 68-2-6, paragraph 2 (第六十八条の二の六第二項)
f.applicability: Japan; PMD Act (医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律, Act No. 145 of 1960), Japanese original text from e-Gov (capture r2). Drugs, medical devices and regenerative medicine products.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Pharmacies, medical institutions, sellers, healthcare professionals, academic bodies and others set by MHLW ordinance
rows.quote: 薬局開設者、病院、診療所若しくは飼育動物診療施設の開設者、医薬品の販売業者、医療機器の販売業者、貸与業者若しくは修理業者、再生医療等製品の販売業者、医師、歯科医師、薬剤師、獣医師その他の医薬関係者又は医学医術に関する学術団体、大学、研究機関その他の厚生労働省令で定める者は、医薬品、医療機器若しくは再生医療等製品の製造販売業者、卸売販売業者、医療機器卸売販売業者等、再生医療等製品卸売販売業者又は外国特例承認取得者が行う医薬品、医療機器又は再生医療等製品の適正な使用のために必要な情報の収集に協力するよう努めなければならない。

rows.quote_en: Pharmacy founders, founders of hospitals, clinics or veterinary clinics, sellers of drugs, sellers, lessors or repairers of medical devices, sellers of regenerative medicine products, physicians, dentists, pharmacists, veterinarians and other medical and pharmaceutical professionals, or academic societies relating to medicine, universities, research institutions and other persons set by MHLW ordinance shall endeavour to cooperate in the collection of information necessary for the proper use of drugs, medical devices or regenerative medicine products carried out by marketing authorisation holders, wholesalers, medical device wholesalers etc., regenerative medicine product wholesalers or foreign special approval holders of drugs, medical devices or regenerative medicine products.

f.title: Healthcare professionals: endeavour to use the information provided and to collect, examine and use necessary information
f.statement: To ensure proper use, pharmacy founders, hospital or clinic founders, physicians, dentists, pharmacists and other medical and pharmaceutical professionals must endeavour, in close mutual cooperation, to use the information provided under Article 68-2-6(1) (including proper maintenance of designated medical devices) and to collect, examine and use other necessary information.
f.clause: Article 68-2-6, paragraph 3 (第六十八条の二の六第三項)
f.applicability: Japan; PMD Act (医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律, Act No. 145 of 1960), Japanese original text from e-Gov (capture r2). Drugs, medical devices and regenerative medicine products.

rows.actor: Pharmacies, hospitals, clinics and healthcare professionals
rows.quote: 薬局開設者、病院若しくは診療所の開設者又は医師、歯科医師、薬剤師その他の医薬関係者は、医薬品、医療機器及び再生医療等製品の適正な使用を確保するため、相互の密接な連携の下に第一項の規定により提供される情報の活用（第六十八条の二第二項第二号ロの規定による指定がされた医療機器の保守点検の適切な実施を含む。）その他必要な情報の収集、検討及び利用を行うことに努めなければならない。

rows.quote_en: Pharmacy founders, founders of hospitals or clinics, or physicians, dentists, pharmacists and other medical and pharmaceutical professionals shall, in order to ensure the proper use of drugs, medical devices and regenerative medicine products, endeavour, in close mutual cooperation, to make use of the information provided under paragraph 1 (including the proper performance of maintenance and inspection of medical devices designated under Article 68-2(2)(2)(b)) and to collect, examine and use other necessary information.

f.title: Regenerative medicine products: record and retain the consignees (MAHs, sellers, medical institutions)
f.statement: A holder of an Article 23-25 approval for a regenerative medicine product, or an appointed MAH for a foreign-manufactured regenerative medicine product, must record the name, address and other ordinance items of the MAHs, sellers and hospital, clinic or veterinary clinic founders that received the product, and retain the record appropriately.
f.clause: Article 68-7, paragraph 1 (第六十八条の七第一項) (Records for regenerative medicine products)
f.applicability: Japan; PMD Act (医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律, Act No. 145 of 1960), Japanese original text from e-Gov (capture r2). Regenerative medicine products.

rows.quote: 再生医療等製品につき第二十三条の二十五の承認を受けた者又は選任外国製造再生医療等製品製造販売業者（以下この条及び次条において「再生医療等製品承認取得者等」という。）は、再生医療等製品を譲り受けた再生医療等製品の製造販売業者若しくは販売業者又は病院、診療所若しくは飼育動物診療施設の開設者の氏名、住所その他の厚生労働省令で定める事項を記録し、かつ、これを適切に保存しなければならない。

rows.quote_en: A person who has received the approval under Article 23-25 for a regenerative medicine product, or an appointed marketing authorisation holder of foreign-manufactured regenerative medicine products (hereinafter in this Article and the next Article "regenerative medicine product approval holder etc.") shall record the name, address and other matters set by MHLW ordinance of the marketing authorisation holders or sellers of regenerative medicine products, or founders of hospitals, clinics or veterinary clinics, that received the regenerative medicine product, and retain the record appropriately.

f.title: Designated regenerative medicine products: healthcare professionals record the patients treated
f.statement: Healthcare professionals handling regenerative medicine products must record the name, address and other ordinance items of the patients for whom they used a regenerative medicine product designated by the Minister.
f.clause: Article 68-7, paragraph 3 (第六十八条の七第三項)
f.applicability: Japan; PMD Act (医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律, Act No. 145 of 1960), Japanese original text from e-Gov (capture r2). Regenerative medicine products designated by the Minister (指定再生医療等製品).

rows.actor: Healthcare professionals handling regenerative medicine products (再生医療等製品取扱医療関係者)
rows.quote: 再生医療等製品取扱医療関係者は、その担当した厚生労働大臣の指定する再生医療等製品（以下この条において「指定再生医療等製品」という。）の使用の対象者の氏名、住所その他の厚生労働省令で定める事項を記録するものとする。

rows.quote_en: Healthcare professionals handling regenerative medicine products shall record the name, address and other matters set by MHLW ordinance of the persons who were the subjects of use of the regenerative medicine products designated by the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare that they were in charge of (hereinafter in this Article "designated regenerative medicine products").

f.title: Medical institution managers: retain records of designated regenerative product use and provide them to the MAH on request for safety measures
f.statement: Managers of hospitals, clinics or veterinary clinics must retain the records made under Article 68-7(3) appropriately and, on request from the designated regenerative product approval holder, appointed MAH or its record-keeping contractor, provide the records to it, but only where needed to take measures to prevent the occurrence or spread of a hazard to public health from use of the product and where it is in the patient's interest.
f.clause: Article 68-7, paragraph 4 (第六十八条の七第四項)
f.applicability: Japan; PMD Act (医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律, Act No. 145 of 1960), Japanese original text from e-Gov (capture r2). Designated regenerative medicine products.

f.applicability: Japan; PMD Act (医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律, Act No. 145 of 1960), Japanese original text from e-Gov (capture r2).

Where any of the following items applies, the person who committed the violation shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than 6 months or a fine of not more than 300,000 yen.

f.title: Penalty: failing to report, reporting falsely or obstructing an inspection under Article 69
